checks_considered: Re-read current TenancyBoundary, DriveReadRepository::forOwner, DriveProvisioner, DriveHandleFactory, NodeReadRepository tree walks, AccessResolver::ancestorChain and storageOf after the seven-file correction

Prior-round adjacency gap is closed for descendants, subtree, ancestors, breadcrumb, ancestorChains and the AccessResolver ancestor walk; enabled mode checks every fetched row against a freshly asserted owning drive even when maintenance bypass is active
